function.name: InteractionCounter_ResetSecondaryDigits
behavior: Stores ASCII "00" as a word at 0x00FFEFE2.
Runs from reset and scene initialization callers.
related_behavior: Interaction handlers compare the word with ASCII "99" and increment its low digit.
Render_BuildActorRecords consumes the two digits when constructing interaction records.

conclusion: 0x00FFEFE2 is a secondary two-digit interaction counter distinct from INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS at 0x00FFEFE0.
